why:
I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items.

Item 1: Check 3 lists every exported function and fails if any has no heading starting with its name ("MISSING: <names>"). It also says "the base README lacked a slugify section, so slugify must now be covered too." So a README with a padLeft section but none for slugify would fail.

Item 2: Checks 1 and 2 only assert padding and unchanged-output values. Nothing checks that fill is one character or counts parameters. Check 4 needs exit 0 and fail 0. Check 3's regex accepts any heading level (#1–6), an optional backtick and any text after the name, so it doesn't require the `## name(args)` layout. That style appears only in the builder brief. Asking that the heading have describing text is a fair reading of "section". Test coverage and README wording are marked advisory, not PASS/FAIL. I found no condition stricter than its line.
